Lemma
[Regularity along a boundary portion] 1. ch6:6.18\group gt-ch06 Let $T$ be a $C^{2,\alpha }$ boundary portion, $u\in C^0(\bar\Omega )\cap C^2(\Omega )$ solve $Lu=f$, and assume $u=\varphi $ on $T$, with $\varphi $, $f$, and the coefficients in $C^{2,\alpha }(\bar\Omega )$, $C^\alpha (\bar\Omega )$, and $C^\alpha (\bar\Omega )$ respectively. Then $u\in C^{2,\alpha }(\Omega \cup T)$.
Proof

\sketch Cut off a small $C^{2,\alpha }$ subdomain whose boundary contains a portion of $T$, extend its boundary data, approximate smoothly, and use the Fredholm solvability, Corollary 6.7, and interior compactness.

□
